title: Machine learning prioritizes exploratory angiogenesis genes in endometriosis endometrium
summary: Transcriptomic analysis of eutopic endometrium (GEO GSE51981) found 238 angiogenesis-related differentially expressed genes in endometriosis; LASSO and random forest, combined with WGCNA, prioritized COL6A1, ERN2 and IL34, and the selected random forest reached an AUC of 0.806 on a second dataset (GSE23339). ERN2 and IL34 differed between groups in that dataset while COL6A1 did not. The work is purely computational: the authors call the cross-dataset AUC exploratory rather than independent validation, the findings do not extend to ectopic lesions, and compound prioritization, docking and dynamics are hypothesis-generating only.
ai_technology: LASSO regression and random forest feature selection and classification on endometrial transcriptomes.
organization: The First Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University

evidence.tested: Genes prioritized in GSE51981 and evaluated cross-dataset in GSE23339 (random forest AUC 0.806).
evidence.unknown: Sample sizes not stated on the page read; no qPCR, IHC or functional validation; relevance to ectopic lesions and therapy unknown.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO and random forest selected the candidate angiogenesis genes and built the classifier.

source_review.scope: Independent review: publisher article page (abstract, methods summary, results, limitations, dates) read; Crossref dates and OpenAlex title search.
